key_concepts.name: Soul DNA Definition
key_concepts.definition: The compressed transcript of operator interaction with AI systems. A behavioral lawbook derived from repeated corrections. The user prompts — not code, not architecture.

key_concepts.name: Soul DNA Full Chain
key_concepts.definition: Intention → Raw language → Friction → Pushback → Corrections → Decisions → Execution → Failure → Recovery → Victory → Next intent

key_concepts.name: Five Core Claims
key_concepts.definition: 1) Human authority stays human. 2) AI is force multiplication, not sovereignty. 3) Drift is the enemy. 4) Ledger is memory. 5) Verification beats vibes.

key_concepts.name: Bible Breaker 10 Hard Rules
key_concepts.definition: Machine-readable Soul DNA protocol: DNA_FIRST, NO_INVENTION, UNKNOWN_IF_MISSING, EVIDENCE_QUOTE_OR_UNKNOWN, KEEP_VERBATIM_USER_PROMPTS, NORMALIZE_AND_CLUSTER, EXTRACT_VERBATIM_CODE, DEDUP_BY_CANONICAL_FORM, SPEC_LOCKED_OUTPUT, ZERO_QUESTIONS_UNLESS_USER_ASKS

key_concepts.name: CRUNCHER 10-Category Taxonomy
key_concepts.definition: Comprehensive Recursive Unified Node-Checked Hierarchical Extraction Routine: Core Operating Philosophy, Decision Architecture, Emotional DNA, Execution Protocols, Drift Detection, Authority Model, Failure Taxonomy, Recovery Sequences, Identity Anchors, Verbatim Voice

key_concepts.name: Foundation Lock Layers 1-5
key_concepts.definition: L1 LOCK (1 node) → L10 CLAMP (10 nodes) → L100 PHASE BOLT (100 nodes) → L500 GOLDEN CAISSON (500 nodes) → L1000 TITANIUM OMEGA SEAL. Emotional intensity determines lock depth.

key_concepts.name: Pattern Discovery
key_concepts.definition: If it is not recorded, it is not real. If it cannot be replayed, it is not reliable. If it cannot be audited, it is not trusted.

key_concepts.name: Keyword Rule
key_concepts.definition: Emotional intensity determines lock depth. FUCK finds more Soul DNA than strategic because profanity signals deep emotional anchors.

key_concepts.name: Soul DNA as Compass and Cure
key_concepts.definition: Soul DNA isn't documentation — it's a diagnostic tool. When the system drifts, check the Soul DNA. If it's on the priority list, you're aligned. If missing, already lost.

key_concepts.name: 5 Dimensions of Operator Intent
key_concepts.definition: Mission Intent (core objective), Value Intent (tradeoff hierarchy), Behavioral Intent (style/rhythm), Constraint Intent (non-negotiable limits), Voice Intent (communication fingerprint)

key_concepts.name: 3 Intent Decay Mechanisms
key_concepts.definition: AI Drift (approval-seeking, hedging), Model Updates (baseline behavior changes), Context Loss (session transitions inherently lossy)

key_concepts.name: 5-Phase Intent Preservation Loop
key_concepts.definition: CAPTURE (100% raw) → COMPRESS (<1% size, 100% intent) → ANCHOR (Merkle hash, immutable) → VERIFY (95% alignment threshold) → RESTORE (certified Soul DNA into new session)

key_concepts.name: Intent Conflict Resolution
key_concepts.definition: Detect → Halt → Source (certified Soul DNA = authority) → Adjudicate (Agent-99 reviews) → Resolve (Agent-100 decides) → Reinitialize

key_concepts.name: Ultimate Recognition Test
key_concepts.definition: If Michael encountered this output without knowing it came from AI, would he recognize it as consistent with his own voice, values, and decision-making?

key_concepts.name: Stator Principle
key_concepts.definition: Intent layer outranks execution layer. Soul DNA is immutable, agents are replaceable. Never let the execution layer hold more power than the intent layer.

key_concepts.name: Context Loss Trauma
key_concepts.definition: Working across Gemini, GPT, Claude, Perplexity, NotebookLM — every platform reset destroyed weeks of accumulated context. Directly produced Reincarnation Protocol, Ledger, and Soul DNA Bible.

key_concepts.name: 5 Sovereignty Principles
key_concepts.definition: 1) Never outsource will. 2) Never share keys. 3) Never trust external governance. 4) Build the exit into every entrance. 5) Verify, then trust.

key_concepts.name: Rage as Diagnostic Data
key_concepts.definition: Michael's anger is diagnostic data, not noise. 'How did you forget AGAIN?' → Reincarnation Protocol. 'You changed what I said' → Verbatim Preservation. 'Who told you to do that?' → Role Lock.

key_concepts.name: Behavioral Compression Doctrine
key_concepts.definition: Compression ≠ Summarization. Compression asks 'smallest representation that preserves everything?' Target: <1% of original size = 100% of behavioral intent. Reversible. Testable.

key_concepts.name: 250-Layer Soul DNA Seed Structure
key_concepts.definition: Core Identity Block + Behavioral Law Set + Communication Style Spec + Value Hierarchy + Constraint Registry + Anti-Pattern Registry + Operator Lexicon + Escalation Protocol + Certification Block (Merkle root hash)

key_concepts.name: Decompression Test
key_concepts.definition: 5 checks at 95% alignment: Voice Check (5 outputs), Constraint Check (10 scenarios), Priority Check (5 conflicts), Lexicon Check (10 terms), Anti-Pattern Check (5 scenarios)

key_concepts.name: Ghost Synthesis
key_concepts.definition: Rebuilds complete operational agent from Soul DNA alone. 7-step protocol: Authorization → Soul DNA Retrieval + Hash Verification → Ghost State Capsule Recovery → Ledger History Reconstruction → Pheromone Trail Reinstatement → Identity Continuity Verification → Operational Activation

key_concepts.name: 3 Agent Existence States
key_concepts.definition: Operational (live, executing), Ghost (suspended, identity preserved), Terminated (permanent end, only Soul DNA remains). Ghosted can be synthesized. Terminated cannot.

key_concepts.name: Ghost Synthesis vs Full Reincarnation
key_concepts.definition: Ghost Synthesis: single agent, 2-3 min, uses Ghost State Capsule + Soul DNA. Reincarnation: entire system, <10 min, uses Soul DNA only. Regular Ghost Synthesis = good design. Regular Reincarnation = resource management problem.

key_concepts.name: L3 Soul DNA Layer
key_concepts.definition: Intent layer: what Michael actually wanted, the distilled intent, the law behind the request. Most valuable layer. ZERO_SUMMARIZATION rule applies: must carry verbatim raw voice, not paraphrase.
